subject: A-ID-PROFILE-01 ID width vs active range
body:
A-ID-PROFILE-01 architecture contract. Not a PASS. A did not edit C RTL or B status law.

SEMANTIC_ID_WIDTH: 32
ACTIVE_RANGE_SOURCE: loaded board/knowledge-pack profile (active_id_bits and/or active_id_max). D implements and wires the profile object. B owns any Manifest/ABI field that carries it. Architecture does not freeze the numeric range (including 24).
AUTHORITATIVE_RANGE_CHECKER: T1 directory / materialization admit (HotDirectory fill). An ID is in the active runtime graph only after this check against the loaded profile.
Pack loader: required INGRESS of the same profile for pack-sourced IDs. Not a second identity law.
DEFENSE_IN_DEPTH_ALLOWED: yes. SPEAR/Q*/walkers MAY re-check candidate_ref against the same loaded profile. That is defensive validation, NOT semantic identity definition. Preferred: profile mask/active_id_max, not a baked candidate_ref[31:24]==0 constant. Hard-coding [31:24]==0 as identity is rejected. Fail = drop that candidate as out-of-profile. ASTRA status mapping of that fail is B-owned; A does not define it.
K_HARD_PROFILE_OWNER: same loaded profile. D wires K_HARD (or equivalent Top-K/slot capacity). C consumes it. A does not freeze the integer. Not ASTRA status.

Live law: AGENT_A 02.4.1 / 02.4.1b / 20.1. Live R1 04.2 still examples 24 significant bits — treat as range example, not a 24-bit type; B should retarget that sentence to the profile parameter. MASTER_CANON nested semantic_id 24 is NOT LIVE.
